metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana lower in November 2024 than any other November from 2012 to 2023, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use VIIRS Active Fire data (FIRMS dataset: `COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NOXEMISSIONS`) - Actually, for active fires, I should use `FIRMS` or `MODIS_FIRE` or better yet, the VIIRS-derived fire product - The correct collection is: `FIRMS` data or `ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1')` for MODIS, or `ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1')` for VIIRS - Actually, VIIRS fires are available via: `NASA/FIRMS/VIIRS` collection (but check availability) - Better approach: Use `NASA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT` or the standard FIRMS VIIRS data - Focus on Punjab and Haryana (northwest India) - Compare November 2024 vs Novembers 2012-2023 2. **Masking strategy**: - Fire counts don't need cloud masking; we want to count fire pixels/detections - Simply count active fire detections (confidence >50 or 75) 3. **Logic**: - For each November (2012-2023 and 2024), count active fire pixels in Punjab+Haryana region - Check if Nov 2024 count < all other years' counts → Answer A (Yes) - If Nov 2024 count >= at least one other year → Answer B (No) - If no data found → C1 - If processing fails → C3 **Key Challenge**: VIIRS fire data availability in GEE and exact collection name. I'll use `NASA/FIRMS/VIIRS` if available, fallback to MODIS. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Punjab and Haryana geometry (approximate bounding box) const punjabHaryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.0, 77.5, 32.5]); try { // Try VIIRS fire collection let fireColl = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS'); // Check if collection exists and has data let testSize = fireColl.filterBounds(punjabHaryana).filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30').size().getInfo(); if (testSize === 0) { // Fallback to MODIS if FIRMS unavailable fireColl = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1'); testSize = fireColl.filterBounds(punjabHaryana).filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30').size().getInfo(); } if (testSize === 0) { print("No fire data found for region in Nov 2024"); print("C1"); return; } // Count fires for each November 2012-2023 and 2024 const fireCountsByYear = {}; const years = Array.from({length: 12}, (_, i) => 2012 + i).concat([2024]); for (const year of years) { const startDate = `${year}-11-01`; const endDate = `${year}-12-01`; const col = fireColl .filterBounds(punjabHaryana) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(img => img.select('confidence')); // Count fire detections (confidence > 50) const fireCount = col .map(img => { const mask = img.gt(50); return mask.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: punjabHaryana, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('confidence'); }) .reduceList(ee.Reducer.sum(), false) .getInfo(); fireCountsByYear[year] = fireCount || 0; print(`Nov ${year}: ${fireCountsByYear[year]} fires`); } const nov2024Count = fireCountsByYear[2024]; const historicalCounts = years.slice(0, -1).map(y => fireCountsByYear[y]); // Check if Nov 2024 is lower than ALL other Novembers const isLowestOrEqual = historicalCounts.every(count => nov2024Count < count); print(`Nov 2024 count: ${nov2024Count}`); print(`Historical min: ${Math.min(...historicalCounts)}`); if (isLowestOrEqual) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } catch (error) { print(`Error: ${error.message}`); print("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
